principle: Do not summarize first. Read the layers that make each argument stand: context, information structure, emotion/rhetoric, background knowledge, authority/power, operational loop, uncertainty.

space_layers.concept_layer: ontology, knowledge graph, schema, semantic fabric, agent communication language
space_layers.information_layer: table/tuple vs triple/graph; data lake/warehouse vs semantic integration; RAG vs GraphRAG
space_layers.context_layer: DX accumulation, enterprise DB fragmentation, national defense/medical/manufacturing domains, sovereign AI pressure
space_layers.emotional_rhetorical_layer: urgency, fear of dependency, promise of explainability, future vision, product/brand persuasion
space_layers.authority_power_layer: domain experts, standards bodies, IBM/Palantir/enterprise vendors, state/defense procurement, cloud/on-prem control
space_layers.operational_layer: FDE/domain expert collaboration, schema design, relation extraction, workflow/agent orchestration, feedback loops
space_layers.counter_uncertainty_layer: ontology overengineering, marketing bias, LLM/RAG alternatives, implementation cost, domain validation bottleneck
space_layers.vectorfl_layer: VectorTube should train layer-reading: evidence quarantine -> layer cards -> cross-source tensions -> mini-space -> HOLD push packet

changed_direction_from_user_feedback: VectorTube is not a summarizer. It is a layer-reading trainer and mini-space builder. If layer detection is weak, stop expansion and improve lenses before adding sources.
next_pass: Deep timestamp claim extraction for the 3 expansion sources, but using the layer lenses above rather than generic summary.
